# Health check script to verify if services are running and report credentials

# Define ports to check
PORTS=(3000 8080)
API_ENDPOINT="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    
    # Use netcat to check if the port is open and responding
    if command -v nc &>/dev/null; then
        if nc -z -w 2 localhost $port; then
            echo "Port $port: UP"
            return 0
        else
            echo "Port $port: DOWN"
            return 1
        fi

    elif timeout 2 bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port" &>/dev/null; then
        echo "Port $port: UP"
        return 0
    else
        echo "Port $port: DOWN"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to read .env file and convert to JSON
read_env_file() {
    local env_file=$1
    local json_data="{}"
    
    if [ -f "$env_file" ]; then
        # Read each line in the env file, ignoring comments and empty lines
        while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
            # Skip comments and empty lines
            if [[ $line =~ ^[^#]*= && ! $line =~ ^# ]]; then
                # Split line into key and value
                key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1)
                value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 2-)
                
                # Remove quotes if present
                value=${value%"}
                value=${value#"}
                value=${value%'}'
                value=${value#'}'
                
                # Add to JSON
                if [ -z "$json_data" ] || [ "$json_data" = "{}" ]; then
                    json_data=$(jq -n --arg k "$key" --arg v "$value" '{($k): $v}')
                else
                    json_data=$(echo "$json_data" | jq --arg k "$key" --arg v "$value" '. + {($k): $v}')
                fi
            fi
        done < "$env_file"
    else
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found" >&2
    fi
    
    echo "$json_data"
}

# Function to add port status to JSON
enrich_with_port_status() {
    local json_data=$1
    local port_statuses="{}"
    
    for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
        if check_port $port >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            port_statuses=$(echo "$port_statuses" | jq --arg p "$port" --arg s "UP" '. + {($p): $s}')
        else
            port_statuses=$(echo "$port_statuses" | jq --arg p "$port" --arg s "DOWN" '. + {($p): $s}')
        fi
    done
    
    # Merge port statuses with original JSON
    echo "$json_data" | jq --argjson statuses "$port_statuses" '. + {services: $statuses}'
}

# Send JSON data to API endpoint
send_to_api() {
    local json_data=$1
    
    if command -v curl &>/dev/null; then
        response=$(curl -s -X POST "$API_ENDPOINT" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$json_data" \
            -w "%{http_code}")
        
        status_code=${response: -3}
        
        if [ "$status_code" -eq 200 ] || [ "$status_code" -eq 201 ]; then
            echo "Successfully reported health status to API"
            return 0

            echo "Warning: API request failed with status code $status_code" >&2
            return 1
        fi
    else
        echo "Warning: curl not found, unable to send health report to API" >&2
        return 1
    fi
}

        exit_status=1
    fi
    echo "----------------------"

    # Add port status to JSON

    # Send to API

        exit_status=1
    fi
else
    echo "Warning: $ENV_FILE not found, skipping health report" >&2
    exit_status=1
fi
